usedFor: Store events in BigCommerce, like “Product Created”, write text into a document in Google Docs.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Created” in BigCommerce, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new BigCommerce product writes text into a chosen Google Docs tab, giving you a running product log.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so set it to add for “Cart Updated”.
